$comment: English texts of data/chat.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the chat's channels, the rules accepted before the first message, the admin's “Add link” window, tagging with “@” and the change of a character's name in the Settings. The names the System gives (generated) are names and stay as they are; `words` is the swear filter, no text. A tag's phone notification has one English form for both genders (the Polish [a|b]).

names.blocked: WARNING: your character's name breaks the Google Play rules on inappropriate content. You must change your name.
names.refused: This name breaks the Google Play rules on inappropriate content. Choose another.
names.label: New character name
names.renamed: Your character's name broke the Google Play rules on inappropriate content, so the System gave it a new one: {name}. You can change it once in the Settings (the cog).
names.once: A character's name can be changed only once. After that this option is locked.
names.locked: This character's name has already been changed once.

accounts.title: Account name
accounts.lead: The chat shows it before the name of the character who writes, e.g. “{example} ({name})”. It is shared by all the characters on your account, so everyone in the chat will see which characters belong to one player.
accounts.rules: 2 to 20 characters: letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes and underscores. It cannot be your login, nor another player's account name or character name.
accounts.every: You can change the account name at most once every {days} days.
accounts.label: Account name
accounts.done: Account name: {name}. The chat shows it next to the character's name.
accounts.same: This is already your account's name.
accounts.taken: Another player already has this name. Choose another one.
accounts.takenByAccount: This name is another player's account name. Choose another one.
accounts.locked: You can change the account name from {date}.
accounts.length: An account name must have 2 to 20 characters.
accounts.sign: An account name cannot contain the sign “{sign}”. Letters of the Latin, Greek or Cyrillic alphabet, digits, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes and underscores are allowed.
accounts.invisible: An account name cannot contain invisible signs.
accounts.alphabet: An account name must be written in one alphabet.
accounts.start: An account name must start with a letter.
accounts.end: An account name must end with a letter or a digit.
accounts.refused: This name breaks the Google Play rules on inappropriate content. Choose another one.
accounts.reserved: This name is reserved. Choose another one.
accounts.login: The account name cannot be your login: the chat shows it to everyone, and your login is better kept to yourself.
accounts.hint: New: the account name. The chat can show it before the character's name, e.g. “{example} ({name})”, for every character on this account. Set it now or later in the Settings (the cog).

texts.news: a tag in the chat waits

link.title: Link in a message
link.lead: The label will show in the chat as a link to the address. Only the admin sends links.
link.label: Label
link.invalid: The address must start with https:// or http:// and cannot contain spaces.

rules: Every player can see the chat. Write with respect: no swearing, insults, threats, adult content, spam or links.
Only the two of you can see a private conversation, but the moderators will also read a reported message.
Do not give out your personal details, such as your address, phone number or password.
Report a message that breaks the rules: press it and choose “Report”. You can hide the messages of someone you do not want to read in the same way.
For breaking the rules, the moderators may mute the chat for an account for a day or for good.
